propositions: bridge_fsck reads prev_snapshot.json and passes field values to ObservedJira.PRESENT classification, so narrowing the snapshot to a keyset {jira_key: {}} silently degrades drift classification without test coverage.

Against a keyset prev fixture, bridge_fsck must report indeterminate status for cases requiring field values and identical classification for membership-only cases, rather than inferring from empty dicts.
Against a full-payload prev fixture, bridge_fsck behavior must remain byte-identical to the current implementation with no regression.
The rebar bridge-fsck CLI exit code and JSON output shape must be unchanged for both keyset and full-payload fixtures.
